say:2:1130515001:0.text: We're here to turn a profit, of course. We were flush with digging tools, explosives... everything you'd need for a treasure hunt.
say:2:1130515001:0.source_cn: 唉，当然是去卖货，我们之前准备了很多开凿山体的工具，炸...
say:2:1130515001:0.male: We're here to turn a profit, of course. We were flush with digging tools, explosives... everything you'd need for a treasure hunt.
say:2:1130515001:0.female: We're here to turn a profit, of course. We were flush with digging tools, explosives... everything you'd need for a treasure hunt.

say:3:1130515002:0.text: But we're flipping a coin and letting fate decide if we should press on or not.
say:3:1130515002:0.source_cn: 你看，我们在扔硬币，想看天意是让我们继续前进，还是干脆...
say:3:1130515002:0.male: But we're flipping a coin and letting fate decide if we should press on or not.
say:3:1130515002:0.female: But we're flipping a coin and letting fate decide if we should press on or not.

say:4:1130515003:0.text: We ran into the Claws on the road. They robbed us and took some workers... even if we make it to Alkali, what would be the point now?
say:4:1130515003:0.source_cn: 我们在路上遭遇流沙之爪，东西被抢，搬运的劳工也被绑走，...

say:5:1130515004:1.text: But if we waste a chance to try again, our losses will be even greater! We have to go on!
say:5:1130515004:1.source_cn: 但是不趁这个机会再搏一把，损失会更大！听我的！前进！

say:6:1130515005:1.text: No, that's insane! With all the risk we need to just cut our losses!
say:6:1130515005:1.source_cn: 不，我们得回去！在这么高的风险面前，保本才重要！
